teacher.source: purejaxgcrl dual_leo_ppo.py and sweeps/craftax/dual_leo_ppo.yaml at eafccd995ac2736df5fbc05ac4bb6b5d58cfcce7
teacher.bc_schedule: 0.1 * max(0, 1 - global_update / 4608), continued through adaptation, not restarted at checkpoints
teacher.learning_rate_schedule: linear to 1e-20 over 4608 updates * 64 minibatches * 2 epochs = 589824 gradient steps
teacher.input_batch_renorm_note: Input BatchRenorm is the official module at eafccd9, including its 1000-step warmup and r_max/d_max clips. Hidden layers stay layer norm. A no-BatchRenorm timing pass was measured before any Dual cell and is not a comparison result.
teacher.grad_steps: scheduled calls and applied Adam steps are recorded separately; an empty minibatch is not an applied step
teacher.transitions: ppo_valid_transitions counts commanded-goal on-policy samples; teacher_valid_samples counts those samples each time a teacher minibatch uses them
teacher.q_target: r_g + 0.995 * max_a Q(next, g) * (1 - achieved_g or world_done); command switch is not terminal for other heads
teacher.invalid_samples: forced NOOP steps are excluded from the PPO loss and the teacher loss
teacher.initialization: fold_in(PRNGKey(seed), 17); the PPO four-way split is unchanged
